t: Is project ka paani aapke zile ki pyaas bujhane wala hai.
Rajasthan ke 17 zilon tak paani pahunchane wala project.
Iska naam hai Ram Jal Setu Link, aur purana naam hai ERCP.
Plan yeh hai ki Chambal aur uski nadiyon, Parbati aur Kalisindh, ke extra paani ko barrages aur canals ke through poorvi Rajasthan tak pahunchaya jaaye.
Jaipur, Ajmer, Tonk, Kota, Bundi, Baran, Jhalawar, Sawai Madhopur, Dausa, Karauli, Dholpur, Bharatpur, Deeg, Alwar, Khairthal-Tijara, Kotputli-Behror aur Beawar.
Karib 3.25 crore logon ko peene ka paani, aur lagbhag 2.8 lakh hectare zameen ko sinchai.
Real estate ka simple sa funda hai, jahan paani, wahan growth.
Is project ka 90% paisa Kendra de raha hai, aur project 91,000 crore ka hai.
Par kaam abhi shuruaati daur mein hai. July 2026 tak sirf 4% paisa hi kharch hua hai.
Kya iska paani aapke zile mein bhi aane wala hai? Comment karke bataiye.
